meta.source: supabase vklgpzrhjvjqhlpfennn public.reservations joined to public.venues
meta.filters: is_deleted = false AND COALESCE(status_simple,'') <> 'Canceled' AND COALESCE(raw->>'venue_seating_area_name','') NOT ILIKE '%bar%'
meta.range_predicate: sargable sr_created_at >= timestamptz 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00+08' AND sr_created_at < ... , never a cast on the column
channel_rules: web: 'Booking Widget' or '%landing page%' or 'PPC%' or in (Nav CTA, Hero CTA, Menu Page, Website, Popup, EDM, What's On)
recep: '%reception%' or '%reservation%' or a venue-desk label (Chinese Library, Cantina, Pacific Place, Hutong, Vesu, Vista, Canton Library) or a comma-separated desk tag string

staff and everything else (EXCLUDED from covers): the ELSE branch. This reproduces the published HK weeks and keeps the residual at zero, so the six published channel columns sum exactly to the covers total.
meta.derivation_note: Rules carried forward from w2026-09-21/_covers_raw.json, which fitted them to the published HK channel values. The London view's CASE does not transfer: it puts the HK reservations desks into staff and its two-word name regex leaves single-word staff names in covers. Ordering matters: recep is evaluated before the staff/else branch.

validation_prior_week.method: recomputed 21-27 Sep 2026 with this week's SQL and compared with the published c values in w2026-09-21/_covers_payload.json
validation_prior_week.verdict: every channel held or moved down slightly, which is cancellations settling out after publication. No channel was reclassified. Aqua HK OpenRice is the largest single move, 402 to 355.
validation_prior_week.trend_check: the 8-week trend reproduces last week's published older weeks within 0.9 percent and always downward: W28 9534 to 9508, W29 10972 to 10959, W30 9749 to 9740, W31 9076 to 9057, W32 9107 to 9074, W33 9809 to 9731.

bulk_import_check.method: grouped 28 Sep to 4 Oct by venue, created hour and source looking for bursts of past-dated covers loaded in one hour, and listed every single booking of 30 or more covers
bulk_import_check.result: no bulk-import backfill found. Every large single-hour entry is forward dated and therefore real demand booked early: The Chinese Library 300 covers in one booking on 2 Oct for 10 Dec (staff-named source, excluded from covers anyway); Hutong 110 covers on 3 Oct for 20 Nov and 103 covers on 30 Sep for service dates 1 Oct to 14 Feb 2027 (reservations desk, counted); Aqua HK 100 covers on 29 Sep for 16 Oct (staff-named, excluded); The Chinese Library 88 covers on 29 Sep including one 80-cover party for 6 Dec (venue desk, counted); Hutong 86 covers on 29 Sep including 80 for 30 Oct (staff-named, excluded); The Chinese Library 60 covers on 2 Oct for 3 Dec (staff-named, excluded). The remaining large single hours are same-day walk-in clusters at Shiro Pacific Place and Dim Sum Library.

residual_other.rule: every booking_source that is not one of the named channels is excluded from covers alongside the staff-named sources, so the six published channel columns sum exactly to the covers total and the residual is zero for every venue and period, as in the published weeks
residual_other.note: both are tiny and neither is a demand channel. HiuChing, JY, JY Ho and Barry are staff names the London two-word regex misses, and are excluded as staff.
